name: year
description: Ano civil de referência dos dados
description_en: Reference calendar year of the data
description_es: Año calendario de referencia de los datos

name: age_group
description: Código do grupo etário do migrante
observations: ABS five-year age groups; TOT is all ages. Beware the code A59, which denotes 5-9 years, not 59
description_en: Code of the migrant's age group
description_es: Código del grupo de edad del migrante

name: arrivals
description: Número de chegadas de migrantes do exterior
observations: Rounded by ABS to the nearest 10 to preserve confidentiality, so components do not always add to totals
description_es: Número de llegadas de migrantes del exterior

name: departures
description: Número de partidas de migrantes para o exterior
observations: Rounded by ABS to the nearest 10 to preserve confidentiality, so components do not always add to totals
description_es: Número de salidas de migrantes hacia el exterior

name: net
description: Migração líquida internacional: chegadas menos partidas
observations: Rounded by ABS to the nearest 10 to preserve confidentiality, so components do not always add to totals. Can be negative
description_en: Net overseas migration: arrivals minus departures
description_es: Migración neta internacional: llegadas menos salidas
